prompt:
Hand-drawn 2D game art for a side-on underground survival game. Clean, confident dark-brown ink linework of even weight, thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner inside, with slightly hand-made wobble. Flat colour fills with one crisp-edged shadow tone and one small highlight, lit evenly from the upper left. A faint paper-grain texture inside the fills only. Big simple shapes and generous plain areas; detail only where the eye should go. Muted, cold palette; warm colours only for fire, scarves and skin. In the spirit of Klei's Don't Starve and Oxygen Not Included and the flat graphic look of the Hilda animated series. Not photoreal, not 3D-rendered, no airbrushed gradients, no glow, no bloom, no rim light, no lens effects, no cast shadow on the ground, no background, no text.
Reference is Esk turnaround. The same character as the reference, same proportions, same colours. FRONT facing viewer detached puppet parts sheet, 3-column 2-row equal square grid, no lines, no labels, transparent generous separation. Row 1: complete pointed hood head with goggles grey fur open dot eyes neck stub; coat torso ONLY scarf collar to hip-length hem, slate blue coat two toggles rope belt, NO head arms legs; image LEFT straight sleeve and brown mitten with grey cuff. Row 2: image RIGHT straight sleeve and mitten, near elbow patch stays on correct side, separately painted not mirrored; image LEFT straight brown trouser leg and boot; image RIGHT straight brown trouser leg with knee patch and boot. Every limb has complete rounded cap extending above pivot, rigid and straight. Plain fills no rendering.
